scenarios.name: red-mana-unavailable-without-mountain-or-swamp
scenarios.why: The red-producing activated ability is restricted to controlling a land with the Mountain or Swamp subtype; the Verge alone has neither subtype.

scenarios.name: red-mana-offered-with-mountain
scenarios.why: A Mountain satisfies the stated land-type restriction, so the red-producing ability is available.

scenarios.name: red-mana-activates-with-swamp
scenarios.why: Controlling a Swamp meets the restriction; activating the available mana ability taps the Verge and adds red mana.
